content.comment_body: Hello, I am following an instructional video but cannot connect my [product_name] to AWS cloud. Here is my configuration: IP address: 192.168.100.3 Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0 Default Gateway: 192.168.100.1 (set as the router gateway) If anyone has any recommendations, please let me know. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble establishing a connection between their [product_name] and AWS cloud, despite following a video guide. Network configuration seems to be the main obstacle, leading to difficulties in accessing cloud features and potential frustration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects a simple and reliable connection to the cloud service by following the provided instructional guide and applying correct network settings.
